test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 10 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Anxious
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. '**Unconcerned'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Anxious"** is an adjective that describes a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome. (चिंतित" or "उत्साहित".)
 
• **'Unconcerned'**
